text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition party leaders and goverment ministers run the final straight to convince voters on their positions over the November 28 referendum to change the constitution.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia says Tamazight Berber language will be the language of all Algerians by the end of this century.
- Algeria is committed to protect and promote human rights with no reserve.
- The draft constitution divides the political community.
